notes: spec_copy is copied verbatim from the spec (question_copy, pre_question_copy, each use case's copy, and voice_samples_uc_case_05). A test fails if it drifts.
flow_copy is quoted verbatim from the use case flows (button and heading text).
draft_copy was written for the build because the spec does not supply it. It needs product and legal review before launch.
poa_authority_note and the no-will wording are OPEN-DECISION-03: draft copy flagged legal_review.
pause and draft_notice say 28 days. If app_settings.draft_retention_days changes, change them too.
Placeholders in braces are filled by the API: {display_name}, {trial_end_date}, {days}, {tasks}, {path_title}, {step}.

spec_copy.question_user_role: What is your connection to them?
spec_copy.question_display_name: What would you like me to call them?
spec_copy.question_residence_state: Did they live in a different state?
spec_copy.question_circumstance: Had they been ill, or was it sudden?
spec_copy.pre_question_circumstance: This helps me know which steps to show you. You don't need to share details.
spec_copy.question_veteran_status: Did they ever serve in the military?
spec_copy.question_estate_plan_status: Did they have a will or estate plan?
spec_copy.question_completed_items: Has anything already been taken care of? Tap anything that's done. It's fine if nothing is.
spec_copy.intro: I'll ask a few gentle questions so I can show you the steps that fit. You can skip anything, and you can stop and come back whenever you need.
spec_copy.poa_authority_note: A power of attorney usually ends when the person dies. After a death, the person named in the will as executor, or someone appointed by the court, usually takes over. An estate attorney can tell you what applies in your state.
spec_copy.place_unknown: When you know where it happened, I can find the right office.
spec_copy.pause: Everything you've shared is saved. There's no rush. To protect your privacy, if this isn't picked up again within 28 days, it will be deleted automatically.
spec_copy.resume_question: Would you like to keep going, or look at something else?
spec_copy.pre_button_notice: When you tap Start journey, your 28 free days begin. You won't need to enter any payment information now.
spec_copy.confirmation_first_case: Your journey has started. Your 28 free days begin today and end on {trial_end_date}. You don't need to enter any payment information now. When your 28 days are up, we'll ask whether you'd like to subscribe. If you don't, nothing is charged, and your account becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted. We'll remind you a few days before your free time ends.
spec_copy.not_today: When you come back, we'll start right here.
spec_copy.small_task_example: Write down who you've already called.
spec_copy.steady_care_example: We can set all of this aside. I'm here. You don't have to do anything right now.
spec_copy.redaction_explanation: You don't need to share that right now. I've removed it to keep it safe. If a task needs it later, I'll tell you exactly who needs it.
spec_copy.draft_notice: I've saved this for you. If it isn't opened for 28 days, it will be deleted automatically to protect your privacy. Opening it any time keeps it safe.
spec_copy.confirmation_existing_trial: Your journey has started. Your free days still end on {trial_end_date}. You don't need to enter any payment information now.
spec_copy.circumstance_question_steady_direct: This next question helps me show the right steps. You don't need to share details. Was the death expected, or was it sudden?
spec_copy.circumstance_question_warm_patient: Take whatever time you need with this one. It helps me to know a little about how it happened, only in general terms. Had they been ill, or was it sudden? You can also skip this.
spec_copy.circumstance_question_brisk_businesslike: One question that changes the plan: was this expected or sudden? A general answer is enough.
spec_copy.circumstance_question_plain_practical: Whether a death was expected or sudden changes who signs the death certificate and how long it can take. Which was it? You can skip this.
spec_copy.circumstance_question_steady_care: We can set all of this aside. I'm here. You don't have to do anything right now.

flow_copy.own_words: Tell it in your own words
flow_copy.figure_out_later: What we can figure out later

draft_copy.ack_first_case: I'm so sorry for your loss. I'm here to help with the practical steps, at your pace.
draft_copy.ack_another_case: I'm so sorry you're facing another loss. We can take this one at its own pace too.
draft_copy.intake_mode_question: Would you like me to ask one question at a time, or would you rather tell me in your own words?
draft_copy.own_words_prompt: Share whatever you'd like, in your own words. I'll pick out what helps and read it back to you.
draft_copy.readback_nothing: Thank you for telling me. I didn't pick up any of the details I use to build the steps, and that's okay.
draft_copy.readback_fix: Of course. Tell me what to change, or answer the questions one at a time.
draft_copy.answer_skipped: That's fine. We can come back to it whenever you like.
draft_copy.answer_unsure: That's okay. We can figure it out later.
draft_copy.display_name_ack: Thank you. I'll call them {display_name} from here on.
draft_copy.circumstance_confirmed: Thank you. That helps me show the right steps.
draft_copy.volunteered_cause_ack: Thank you for telling me. You don't need to share more than you want to.
draft_copy.loss_survivor_offer: If it would ever help, there are people who support families after a suicide loss. You can find them at afsp.org whenever you want.
draft_copy.step_added: I've added a step to your journey: {tasks}.
draft_copy.veterans_crisis_line_added: I've also added the Veterans Crisis Line to your support resources.
draft_copy.no_will_reassure: That's very common, and it doesn't mean things will go badly. I've added a step that explains what happens next.
draft_copy.family_disagreement_ack: That sounds really hard. I won't take sides, and I can't help settle it. An estate attorney can, so I've added that as a step.
draft_copy.attorney_task_added: This is a time to talk to an estate attorney. I've added that as a step, and I'll keep showing you everything else I can help with.
draft_copy.attorney_referral_line: Cairn can't give legal advice and isn't a substitute for an attorney. An estate attorney can tell you what applies in your state.
draft_copy.outside_us_ack: Thank you for telling me. Cairn doesn't cover deaths outside the United States yet, and I'm sorry I can't guide you through it. Your case is saved. The funeral home, and an attorney who handles international matters, are good places to start.
draft_copy.outside_us_not_covered: Cairn doesn't cover deaths outside the United States yet. The funeral home and an attorney can help with the steps that apply.
draft_copy.certificate_may_be_pending_note: When a medical examiner or coroner is involved, the death certificate may first show the cause as pending. Some offices and companies accept a pending certificate, and some wait for the final one.
draft_copy.fiduciary_offer: I can keep a shorter pace and leave out the explainers.
draft_copy.name_fallback_offer: If you'd rather, I can say the person who died.
draft_copy.name_fallback_question: Which would you like me to use?
draft_copy.resume_where: Last time we were talking about {step}.
draft_copy.resume_start: We hadn't started the questions yet.
draft_copy.resume_done: You'd answered everything you wanted to.
draft_copy.all_questions_done: That's everything I need for now.
draft_copy.journey_preview_intro: Here are the first four weeks. Nothing here is due today.
draft_copy.not_yet_saved: That's fine. Everything you've shared is saved.
draft_copy.pre_button_notice_existing_trial: Starting this journey doesn't change your free days. They still end on {trial_end_date}. You won't need to enter any payment information now.
draft_copy.subscription_needed_new_journey: Your free 28 days have ended, so a subscription is needed to start a new journey. Everything you've shared is saved, and you can keep working on this case in the meantime.
draft_copy.death_not_yet_ack: Thank you for telling me. I'm so sorry you're going through this.
draft_copy.death_not_yet_explain: Cairn's journeys start after a death. You can save what you've shared now, or come back whenever you need to.
draft_copy.time_sensitive_intro: These are the most time-sensitive right now.
draft_copy.small_task_open: Take your time. There's nothing else you need to do today.
draft_copy.overwhelm_ack: This is a lot. Let's slow down. There's nothing you have to answer right now.
draft_copy.overwhelm_offer: Would you like to pause, or do one small thing?
draft_copy.support_988: You can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.
draft_copy.support_veterans_crisis_line: Veterans and their families can reach the Veterans Crisis Line by dialing 988 and pressing 1.
draft_copy.risk_ack: I'm really glad you told me. Your safety matters more than any of this.
draft_copy.emergency_911: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911.
draft_copy.safety_next: Whenever you're ready, and only if you want to, we can pick this back up.
draft_copy.path_expected_loss_why: Because they had been ill, this starts with the steps that usually follow an expected death.
draft_copy.path_sudden_loss_why: Because the death was sudden, this allows for a death certificate that may take a little longer.
draft_copy.path_sudden_loss_investigation_title: a sudden loss that may be reviewed
draft_copy.path_sudden_loss_investigation_why: Because a medical examiner or coroner may be involved, this starts with what their review means for you.
draft_copy.path_general_why: This covers the steps most families need in the first four weeks. It will adjust as you add details.

draft_copy.label_estate_plan_status_yes_location_kn: Yes, and I know where it is
draft_copy.label_estate_plan_status_yes_location_un: Yes, but I'm not sure where it is

draft_copy.label_completed_items_none_or_unsure: Nothing yet, or I'm not sure
